markets.description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike match between Gentle Mates and HOTU in the IEM Rio: Global Closed Qualifier Playoffs, scheduled for January 21 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Gentle Mates" if Gentle Mates win the match against HOTU.

This market will resolve to "HOTU" if HOTU win the match against Gentle Mates.
